{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many rows have commas
n_commas = has_commas.sum()

# Display the rows with commas
qa_orders = sales[has_commas]

# Confirm they are exactly the 6 QA orders
print(f"Number of rows with commas in revenue: {n_commas}")
print(f"First few of these: \n{qa_orders.head()}")

# Extract the revenue values to confirm they are all 999,999.99
qa_revenues = qa_orders['revenue'].unique()
print(f"Unique revenue values in QA rows: {qa_revenues}")"}
